sources.title: Venmo fees
sources.claim: Lists $0 to send from balance/debit/bank, 3% credit-card send fee, free standard transfer, Instant Transfer 1.75% (min $0.25, max $25), 2.99% personal goods-and-services seller fee, business 1.9%+$0.10 and Tap to Pay 2.29%+$0.09, ATM $2.50 out of network, check deposit 2%/5% (min $6), cash reload $3.74, crypto fee tiers 2.20%/2.00%/1.80%/1.50%.
caveats: Visible update date is June 27, 2024, older than the help articles; fees are live config.
Tap to Pay fee differs from CR-VE-24 by one cent fixed component.

sources.title: Earn Up to 5% Cash Back with Venmo Stash
sources.claim: Stash gives 1% base, 2% after $250 and 5% after $1,500 qualifying monthly spend at participating brands via Venmo Debit Card or Venmo checkout; capped at $100 per calendar month; tier holds through the current and following month; cash back to balance within a few days and does not expire.
caveats: Excludes P2P, real-money gaming, money transfers, refunded purchases.
Search index shows an alternate tier path (see CR-VE-32).
sources.local_note: 1% from day one; 2% at $250 monthly qualifying spend; 5% requires $1,500 qualifying monthly spend; max $100 cash back per calendar month.

sources.title: Venmo Stash (help article vhel225)
sources.page_scope: Help article; fetched body described Limited Time Offers
sources.claim: Limited Time Offers require the Venmo Debit Card, must be activated before purchase, cannot be deactivated, typically pay within 30 days to balance, and are reduced proportionally on refunds.
caveats: Article title says Venmo Stash but body fetched covered Limited Time Offers; payout timing (30 days) differs from Stash marketing page (a few days).
sources.local_note: Most cash back offers are typically paid within 30 days; offers must be activated before purchase and cannot be deactivated.

sources.title: Always-on Cash Back
sources.page_scope: Help article for Stash always-on cash back
sources.claim: Enroll via Me tab > Turn on Venmo Stash; 1%/2%/5% tiers at $250/$1,500 monthly spend; only one Everything store (Amazon, Walmart or Target) at a time with 30-day wait to switch; $100/month combined cap; stacks with Limited Time Offers.
caveats: Says cash back typically within a few days, sometimes immediately, while citing 30 days in Rewards Terms.
sources.local_note: You can only earn cash back from one of Amazon, Walmart, or Target at a time; 30-day wait to switch; up to $100 per calendar month combined.

sources.title: Venmo Debit Card
sources.claim: Choose a design and order; Stash tiers; free MoneyPass ATM withdrawals (~40K US), $2.50 otherwise; Apple Pay/Google Pay before card arrives; direct deposit up to 2 days early; issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A.; pass-through FDIC insurance.
caveats: Early direct deposit depends on payer timing.
Card colors subject to availability.
sources.local_note: Withdraw cash at no cost from 40K MoneyPass ATMs; $2.50 ATM fee elsewhere; paycheck up to 2 days early; issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A.

sources.title: Pay with Venmo Online and In Apps
sources.claim: Checkout with Venmo balance or any linked payment method at participating apps/sites; eligible transactions covered by Purchase Protection; using balance requires identity verification.
caveats: Not available at all merchants.
Purchase Protection terms and limitations apply.
sources.local_note: Venmo checkout uses balance or any linked payment method; not available at all merchants; Purchase Protection on eligible transactions.

sources.title: Venmo Credit Card rewards
sources.claim: 3% dining and entertainment (incl. streaming) and Venmo online/in-app checkout, 1% everything else, plus 1% when splitting a purchase in Venmo within 30 days (up to 4%); daily cash back deposited to Venmo account; no annual fee; eligibility 18+, US, Venmo account 30+ days old.
caveats: Category list on the page appears to mention travel, bills and groceries near the 3% section while also naming groceries/utilities at 1%; treat category mapping as unresolved.
Applies to cards approved after 9/24/2026 per CR-VE-08.
sources.local_note: Up to 4%: 3% dining & entertainment plus 1% bonus when split via Venmo within 30 days of purchase; 1% on everything else; daily cash back.

sources.title: Venmo Credit Card Rewards Program
sources.page_scope: Help article: rewards by approval date
sources.claim: Cards approved before 9/24/2026: 3% top category, 2% second, 1% other and on P2P, credited at end of statement period. Approved after 9/24/2026: 3% dining & entertainment (+1% split), 3% Venmo checkout, 1% else, posted daily after transactions complete.
caveats: Two concurrent reward programs by cohort; account-specific.
sources.local_note: Approved before 9/24/2026: 3% top spend category, 2% second, 1% other; added at statement end. Approved after 9/24/2026: daily rewards.

sources.title: Cash Back Crypto Terms & Conditions
sources.page_scope: Legal terms for Cash Back to Crypto
sources.claim: Credit card holders may opt in to auto-buy a selected crypto asset with cash back; minimum $1.00; no buy fee but sell fee applies; cash back typically transferred 1-3 days after each statement period; timing of purchase not known in advance; opt out anytime in Rewards section.
caveats: Terms are written around statement-period cash back, which conflicts with daily rewards for post-9/24/2026 cardholders (CR-VE-08).
sources.local_note: Cash Back must be at least $1.00 to purchase Crypto Assets; typically transferred 1-3 days after the end of each Statement Period.

sources.title: Crypto Transfers
sources.claim: Identity verification required; free to Venmo/PayPal users; external wallets incur network fees; cannot be cancelled or reversed; unverified recipients have 30 days to verify or crypto returns; PYUSD only to supporting wallets; network selection must match.
caveats: Wrong address or network results in permanent loss.
sources.local_note: Crypto transfers cannot be cancelled or reversed; network fees apply to external wallets; unverified recipients have 30 days to verify.

sources.title: Cryptocurrency FAQ
sources.page_scope: Help article: crypto eligibility, limits, fees
sources.claim: Personal profiles only, identity verification incl. SSN/ITIN; supports BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH, SOL, LINK, PYUSD; $20,000 weekly and $50,000 rolling 12-month purchase limits; $25,000 weekly transfer limit; PYUSD buy/sell no fee; holds up to 7 days.
caveats: Names Venmo Digital (PayPal subsidiary, NY licensed) while S09 names Paxos for custody/trading.
sources.local_note: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Solana, Chainlink, PayPal USD; weekly purchase $20,000; 12-month $50,000; weekly transfer $25,000.

sources.title: Selling Cryptocurrency on Venmo
sources.claim: Sell from Crypto tab; proceeds to Venmo balance typically immediately, may be held up to seven days for review; HIFO used for gains/losses; sales may fail.
caveats: Fee varies by amount; PYUSD no fee.
sources.local_note: Venmo uses highest-in-first-out (HIFO) for gains and losses; proceeds may be held up to seven days.

sources.title: Sending & Requesting Money
sources.claim: Pay/Request by name, username, phone or email; confirm recipient's phone/email is verified before paying; pay multiple people and split evenly or adjust amounts.
sources.local_note: Before you send a payment to someone's phone number or email address, have the recipient confirm it is verified on their Venmo account.

sources.title: Settling Up Group Expenses
sources.claim: Groups hub shows who owes whom, Pay button settles shares, members can Mark as paid for outside settlements.
sources.local_note: Groups hub > select group > Pay; Group summary > Members > Mark as paid.

sources.title: Payments & Requests FAQ
sources.claim: Payments usually immediate; sender's bank may need up to 5 business days when Pending; payment method cannot change after sending; scheduled payments and requests available; self-payments prohibited.
sources.local_note: You can't change your payment method after a payment has been sent; scheduled payments and requests are available.

sources.title: Manage your Venmo privacy settings
sources.claim: Public, Friends only or Private per payment and as default; the more restrictive of the two participants' settings applies; only sender sees payment method; past payments can be hidden (vhel191).
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Three options: Public, Friends, Private; Venmo uses the more restrictive setting between payment partners.

sources.title: Instant Bank Transfer FAQ
sources.claim: Instant transfer to eligible US bank or Visa/Mastercard/Discover debit card typically within 30 minutes for 1.75% (min $0.25, max $25) deducted from the amount.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Typically within 30 minutes; 1.75% fee, minimum $0.25, maximum $25, deducted from the transfer amount.

sources.title: Standard Bank Transfers FAQ
sources.claim: Standard ACH transfer is free, typically 1 business day, up to 3; after 7pm ET weekdays or weekends/holidays processes next business day.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Standard ACH transfer free; typically one business day, up to 3; after 7pm ET processed next business day.

sources.title: Personal Profile Bank Transfer Limits
sources.claim: Unverified: $999.99/week to bank. Verified: $5,000 per transfer, $19,999.99/week; instant minimum $0.26; add money $10,000/week from bank, $3,000/week from debit card; rolling weekly.
caveats: Venmo may change limits by account history.
sources.local_note: Verified: up to $5,000.00 per individual transfer and $19,999.99 per week; unverified $999.99 weekly.

sources.title: Personal Profile Payment Limits
sources.claim: Unverified $299.99/week combined; verified up to $60,000/week; rolling weekly limits.
caveats: Limits subject to periodic review.
sources.local_note: Unverified weekly limit $299.99; verified up to $60,000 per week; rolling weekly.

sources.title: Identity Verification
sources.claim: Verification (legal name, SSN/ITIN, government ID) needed to pay from balance, send $300+/week, transfer $1,000+/week, receive goods/services payments, manage organization accounts; unverified users can still receive, cash out, and pay from external methods.
caveats: Users without SSN/ITIN cannot verify.
sources.local_note: Verification needed to use Venmo balance for payments; triggered at $300+ weekly sends or $1,000+ weekly bank transfers.

sources.title: Cancel Payment
sources.claim: Sent payments cannot be cancelled; pending payments to unverified recipients can be taken back; wrong-friend payments resolved by asking for repayment; stranger payments go to Support; bank stop on completed payment creates a Venmo account loss.
sources.local_note: Once a payment is sent there is no way to cancel it; contacting your bank to stop a completed payment creates a loss on your Venmo account.

sources.title: I accidentally paid a stranger on Venmo
sources.claim: Wrong-recipient payments to strangers: contact Support with username, amount, date; opening a dispute will not fix it.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Opening a dispute on a payment you sent to the wrong person will not rectify the situation.

sources.title: Business Profile Transaction Fees
sources.claim: Business profile: 1.9% + $0.10 for Venmo payments; Tap to Pay 2.29% + $0.10; seller fees not refunded.
caveats: Conflicts with fees page (2.29% + $0.09) and a search-index excerpt (2.9% + $0.09).
sources.local_note: Tap to Pay: 2.29% + $0.10 of the payment total; direct: 1.9% + $0.10.

sources.title: Business profiles (create and basics)
sources.claim: Create a business profile from the Me tab or venmo.com; no monthly or setup fee; accept Venmo, contactless and digital wallets via Tap to Pay and QR code.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
Index excerpt quoted Tap to Pay at 2.9% + $0.09, conflicting with CR-VE-01 and CR-VE-24.
sources.local_note: Create business profile from Me tab drop-down or Settings; no monthly or setup fees.

sources.title: Venmo Credit Card FAQs
sources.claim: Eligible users see a credit card section in Cards tab; customizable push/email notifications; pay bill from Venmo balance; works with Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay; rewards depend on approval date (9/24/2026); Synchrony support 855-878-6462 24/7.
sources.local_note: Your Venmo Credit Card rewards experience depends on when you were approved; issued by Synchrony Bank.

sources.title: Venmo Credit Card billing and security
sources.claim: Pay bill via Cards > View and Pay from balance or verified bank; Autopay with selectable funding, bank backup required if balance; temporarily disable physical card (virtual card and in-app use continue).
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: While disabled, authorizations are blocked on the physical card; you may still use your virtual card online.

sources.title: My Venmo Debit Card is lost, stolen, or damaged
sources.claim: Replace card in Cards tab; lock card from card image; teen debit card lock toggle.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Replace lost, stolen, or damaged card from Cards tab; lock your card by tapping card image.

sources.title: Contact us and disputes
sources.claim: In-app chat 8am-10pm CT daily; phone (855) 812-4430 8am-8pm CT; dispute most transactions via Me > transaction > Need Help?.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Chat With Us 8 a.m.-10 p.m. CT; phone (855) 812-4430; dispute via transaction > Need Help? > Submit Issue.

sources.title: California Regulatory Agency Legal Information
sources.claim: Regulator complaint routes: California DFPI 1-866-275-2677; NY DFS 1-877-226-5697.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: California DFPI 1-866-275-2677; NYS DFS Consumer Assistance 1-877-BANK-NYS.

sources.title: Splitting & Sharing Purchases
sources.claim: Select a purchase, tap Split, choose users; Venmo sends charge requests.
caveats: Observed via search-engine index excerpt of the official page; the page body itself was not fetched in this pass.
sources.local_note: Splitting a purchase on Venmo will send a charge request to the users you include.

sources.title: Search-index excerpt: Stash bundle tiers via auto-reload / direct deposit
sources.page_scope: Unattributed index excerpt surfaced for Venmo Stash/Rewards Terms queries
sources.claim: An index excerpt describes 1% at bundle merchants, 2% with low-balance auto-reloads, 5% with $500+ monthly direct deposit, one bundle at a time, highest tier applies (not 7%).
caveats: Could not locate this text on any fetched page; contradicts spend-threshold tiers on CR-VE-02/04/05; possibly superseded terms. Do not implement from this.
sources.local_note: 1% base at bundle merchants; 2% with auto-reloads; 5% with $500+ Direct Deposit per calendar month; highest tier applies.
